title: Finite-stage finite-Tor-amplitude complexes form a triangulated subcategory
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, an integer $n\geq1$, and a scheme $Y$; put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, and let $D^b_c(Y,A)\subset D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ be the full triangulated subcategory of bounded complexes with constructible cohomology sheaves [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, lem-weil-proetale-dbc-triangulated]. Let $P$ be the property of $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$: $K\in D^b_c(Y,A)$ and $K$ has finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. Then $P$ is closed under isomorphisms and defines a full triangulated subcategory of $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory]: $0$ satisfies $P$; $K$ satisfies $P$ if and only if $K[m]$ does, for every $m\in\mathbf Z$ (if $K$ has Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ then $K[m]$ has Tor amplitude in $[a-m,b-m]$); and for every distinguished triangle $K\to L\to M\to K[1]$ with $K$ and $M$ satisfying $P$, also $L$ satisfies $P$ (if $K$ and $M$ have Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$, so does $L$).

source.place: Cohomology on Sites, Lemma 21.46.4 (Tag 08G2, label lemma-cone-tor-amplitude), part (2), for the ringed site $(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},(A_{E,n})_Y)$; together with lem-weil-proetale-dbc-triangulated for the constructibility part
